name: English Stud
description: English Stud is a 7-card stud variant where players have the unique option to exchange cards during the deal. Deal and play follow standard 7-card stud, but after each betting round (following the 5-card and 6-card streets), each player can optionally exchange one card for a new one. This card exchange feature distinguishes English Stud from traditional 7-card stud.

content.text: English Stud is a 7-card stud variant where players have the unique option to exchange cards during the deal. Deal and play follow standard 7-card stud, but after each betting round (following the 5-card and 6-card streets), each player can optionally exchange one card for a new one. This card exchange feature distinguishes English Stud from traditional 7-card stud.
British adaptation of American 7-card stud; Pot-Limit and club rules common in UK card rooms.

Two to six players. Six is the maximum for this variant so the deck suffices for the deal and two optional single-card exchange rounds; with five or fewer players a seventh face-down card may be dealt as in standard seven-card stud. Best with five or six players for balance of action and card availability.
Same as 7-card stud. Betting structure often Pot-Limit or Spread-Limit (local rules).
